readme:
# Flippa Scraper

Get listings from [Flippa](https://flippa.com/), the marketplace for websites, online stores, SaaS products, apps and domains. Give the actor a Flippa search address or pick a property type, and it returns one record per listing: asking price, monthly revenue and profit, profit multiple, age, type, industry, location, who lists it, badges and the link. No login and no API key are needed.

## What you get

- One record per listing from the Flippa search pages, 50 listings per page.
- Websites, apps and domains, each searched on its own, or any Flippa search address you paste.
- Several pages in one run. Set `maxItems` and the actor reads as many pages as it needs.
- Each listing once per run, even if it shows up on more than one page.
- Prices and monthly figures as numbers, with the currency in its own field.
- A run that is interrupted continues where it stopped. Listings already delivered are not delivered or charged again.
- You pay only for listings that were saved to the dataset.

## Use with AI agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client, such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain or LlamaIndex.

**MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/flippa-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `flippa-scraper` to list 100 online stores for sale on Flippa with their asking price, monthly profit and multiple as a CSV."

## Input

| Field | Type | Description | Default |
|-------|------|-------------|---------|
| `startUrls` | string[] | Flippa search addresses, for example `https://flippa.com/search?filter%5Bproperty_type%5D=website`. The page number in the address is the first page read. | none |
| `propertyTypes` | string[] | `website` (websites, online stores, SaaS and content sites), `app` or `domain`. Each type is searched on its own. | `website` when no address is given |
| `listingTypes` | string[] | Keep only rows whose Type on the card contains one of these words, such as `Ecommerce`, `SaaS`, `Content` or `Service`. Other rows are dropped after reading, so a narrow filter needs more pages. | all |
| `sortBy` | string | `most_recent`, `most_active`, `ending_soonest`, `highest_price`, `lowest_price` or `most_profitable`. Applies to `propertyTypes`. For `startUrls` use the sort in the address. | Flippa order |
| `maxItems` | integer | Listings to return across all inputs. 0 uses 100. | `100` |
| `maxPages` | integer | Search pages to read for each address or property type. 0 uses 20. | `20` |
| `includeDetails` | boolean | Open each listing page as well, for its full title, description, image, category name, and the monthly figures, multiples and asking price in the listing currency. One extra request per listing. | `false` |

Example, online stores and domains:

```json
{
  "propertyTypes": ["website", "domain"],
  "maxItems": 200
}
```

Example, a search address, online stores only:

```json
{
  "startUrls": ["https://flippa.com/search?filter%5Bproperty_type%5D=website&sort_alias=most_recent"],
  "listingTypes": ["Ecommerce"],
  "maxItems": 100
}
```

## Output

Each record has these fields. Fields that a card does not show are `null`.

| Field | Example |
|-------|---------|
| `id` | `"11901406"` |
| `url` | `"https://flippa.com/11901406-premium-17-year-vape-ecommerce-business-..."` |
| `title` | `"Premium 17-Year Vape eCommerce Business \| $766K TTM Revenue ..."` |
| `heading` | `"Ecommerce \| Electronics"` |
| `property_type` | `"Ecommerce"` |
| `category` | `"Electronics"` |
| `price_type` | `"asking"` or `"auction"` |
| `currency` | `"USD"` |
| `asking_price`, `original_price`, `price_reduction_percent` | `850000`, `null`, `null` |
| `starting_price`, `current_bid`, `buy_it_now_price`, `bids` | Auction figures, when the card shows them |
| `monthly_revenue`, `monthly_profit` | `63900`, `37100` |
| `profit_multiple`, `revenue_multiple` | `1.9`, `null` |
| `monthly_currency`, `native_asking_price` | Currency of the monthly figures and the asking price in that currency. Filled when `includeDetails` is on, and for United States listings; see Limitations |
| `age_years`, `age_text` | `17`, `"17 years"` |
| `monthly_visitors`, `monthly_page_views`, `monthly_downloads`, `monetization` | When the card shows them |
| `location`, `region`, `country` | `"AZ, United States"`, `"AZ"`, `"United States"` |
| `managed_by`, `managed_by_text` | `"flippa_broker"`, `"Brokered by Flippa"` |
| `seller_name` | Broker name shown on the card, for brokered listings |
| `data_verified`, `verified_sources` | `true`, `["Google Analytics"]` |
| `first_access_only`, `goes_public_on`, `time_left` | First Access listings: `true`, `"2026-11-19"`, `"12 Days Left"` |
| `partial_sale` | `"Partial Sale: 95% Equity"` |
| `other_metrics` | Labelled figures with no field of their own |
| `image_url`, `description`, `detail_category`, `detail_fetched` | Filled when `includeDetails` is on |
| `search_url`, `page`, `position_on_page`, `total_results_on_source` | Where the row came from |
| `scraped_at` | `"2026-11-07T10:00:00Z"` |

Output sample:

```json
{
  "id": "11901406",
  "url": "https://flippa.com/11901406-premium-17-year-vape-ecommerce-business-766k-ttm-revenue",
  "title": "Premium 17-Year Vape eCommerce Business | $766K TTM Revenue | Aprox $445K SDE",
  "property_type": "Ecommerce",
  "category": "Electronics",
  "price_type": "asking",
  "currency": "USD",
  "asking_price": 850000,
  "monthly_revenue": 63900,
  "monthly_profit": 37100,
  "monthly_currency": "USD",
  "native_asking_price": null,
  "profit_multiple": 1.9,
  "age_years": 17,
  "location": "AZ, United States",
  "country": "United States",
  "managed_by": "flippa_broker",
  "data_verified": true,
  "verified_sources": ["Google Analytics"],
  "search_type": "website",
  "page": 1
}
```

## Pricing

Pay-per-event pricing. You pay only for listings that were saved to the dataset.

| Event | Price |
|-------|-------|
| Actor start (`actor-start`) | $0.001 per run |
| Listing scraped (`listing-result`) | $0.001 per listing ($1.00 per 1,000) |

The start event is charged once per run, together with the first saved listing. A run that returns nothing is not charged. If you set a maximum cost per run, the actor stops before it goes over that limit.

## Limitations

- The actor reads the public search pages. It does not log in, so it cannot read anything that needs an account.
- Listing pages on Flippa show little more than the search cards to visitors who are not logged in. `includeDetails` adds the full title, description, image, category name and the figures in the listing currency, and costs one more request per listing.
- Search cards carry no listing photo. `image_url` stays empty unless `includeDetails` is on, and then it is the preview image Flippa publishes for the listing.
- Property types other than `website`, `app` and `domain` are passed to Flippa as they are. Flippa answers a value it does not know with an empty result.
- Flippa shows "10,000+" for very large searches. `total_results_on_source` is empty in that case.
- Auction fields (`current_bid`, `bids`, `buy_it_now_price`) are filled when the card shows them. Nearly every card on the sale pages shows an asking price only.
- A business younger than one year shows "<1 year" on the card. `age_text` keeps that text and `age_years` is `null`.
- Flippa shows search card prices in US dollars. A listing posted in another currency (for example pounds) shows its monthly revenue and monthly profit in that currency on the card, still labelled USD, and the card gives no sign of it. The profit multiple on the card is the dollar price divided by that profit, so it can differ from the listing page (listing 12010665 shows 5.0x on the card and 3.8x on its page). For that reason `monthly_currency` is `USD` only for United States listings; for all other listings `monthly_currency` and `profit_multiple` are empty on search results. Turn on `includeDetails` for these rows: `monthly_currency`, `monthly_revenue`, `monthly_profit`, `profit_multiple`, `revenue_multiple` and `native_asking_price` then come from the listing page in the listing currency.
- Figures are those the seller or broker published. The actor does not check them.
- The actor never opens the bidding, offer, watch list or account pages of Flippa.

## FAQ

**Which search addresses work?**
Addresses that start with `https://flippa.com/search`. Copy one from your browser after you set the filters on Flippa. Addresses of single listings are not search addresses; use `includeDetails` to open listing pages.

**How many listings can I get?**
Each page holds 50 listings. `maxItems` and `maxPages` set the limits. Flippa reports about 4,400 website listings at the time of writing.

**Why do some rows have no revenue or profit?**
Domains and some other listings do not publish them. The fields are `null` then.

**Why is the price in US dollars?**
`currency` is the currency of the asking, starting, bid and original prices, and Flippa shows these in US dollars. The monthly figures can be in the listing's own currency; `monthly_currency` says which when it is known. For listings outside the United States, `monthly_currency` and `profit_multiple` need `includeDetails`; without it both are empty.

**Can I filter by industry or price?**
Set the filters on Flippa and paste the address into `startUrls`, or use `listingTypes` to keep a type of business after reading.

**What happens when a run is interrupted?**
It continues from the last saved page and does not deliver or charge the same listings twice.

**Do I need an account or an API key?**
No.
